notes: THIS MOD HAS NO QUESTABLE CONTENT, AND THE ONE ITEM IT REGISTERS IS NOT SURVIVAL-OBTAINABLE. Champions Unofficial 2.1.10.2 (Forge 1.20.1, mods.toml modId="champions", forge "[47,)", optional scalinghealth dependency) is a mob-AFFIX system, exactly as the brief suspected. VERIFICATION: 306 jar entries; the strict scan finds ONE item key, item.champions.champion_egg, with one matching models/item/champion_egg.json and no blocks. THE EGG IS DROPPED, NOT QUESTED: data/champions has advancements/, affix_setting/, damage_type/, loot_modifiers/, loot_tables/ and tags/ but NO recipes/ directory, and champion_egg appears in no loot table; the only bytecode that mentions it besides ModItems (registration) and the client renderer is ChampionsCommand, and the lang file confirms it with 'commands.champions.egg.success = Created new %s'. It is produced solely by /champions egg, so an item task for it is uncompletable in survival - dropped, and there is nothing left to build a chain from. ENTITIES: the two entity.champions.* keys are arctic_bullet and enkindling_bullet - the icicle and fire bolt fired by the Arctic and Enkindling affixes. Both are projectiles with no spawn egg, no loot table and no spawn rule; a kill task on either would be permanently uncompletable. Excluded. THE ACTUAL CONTENT IS AFFIXES AND RANKS, NEITHER OF WHICH IS ADDRESSABLE AS AN ID: 16 affixes ship as data/champions/affix_setting/*.json - adaptable, arctic, dampening, desecrating, enkindling, hasty, infested, knocking, lively, magnetic, molten, paralyzing, plagued, reflective, shielding, wounding - each with a category (offence/defence/utility), an enable flag, a mobList with blacklist/whitelist permission and a tier min/max range. Five ranks are named in lang as rank.champions.title.1-5: Common, Skilled, Elite, Legendary, Ultimate. Champions attach to VANILLA mobs listed in data/champions/tags/entity_types/allow_champions.json (blaze, cave_spider, creeper, drowned, elder_guardian, ender_dragon, enderman, endermite, evoker, ghast, giant, guardian, hoglin, husk, illusioner, magma_cube, phantom, piglin, pillager and the rest of the vanilla hostile roster), so 'kill a Legendary champion' is a vanilla entity id plus NBT, not a champions: id, and cannot be written as kill:champions:something. THE ONE HOOK A PACK CAN USE is not an item either: the mod registers the statistic stat.champions.champion_mobs_killed and the hidden advancement champions:kill_a_champion (parent minecraft:adventure/kill_a_mob, challenge frame), and its global loot modifier champions:champion_loot rolls one enchanted book per rank tier out of data/champions/loot_tables/champion_loot.json. If the pack wants Champions represented, the honest form is a single stat- or advancement-triggered quest in a combat chapter, rewarding nothing from this namespace. CONSENSUS: absent from moddb.json, consistent with having no questable items. Do not pad this into a chain.
